name: Schneizlreuth (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, light blue and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Schneizlreuth (clover leaves and a wheel on blue and yellow).
history: The arms were introduced in 1981 on the basis of a resolution of the municipal council with the consent of the government of Upper Bavaria, whose letter is dated 3 June 1981; the flag carries the municipal colours.

features.role: Schneizlreuth arms — clover leaves and wheel
